info.title: Designfy
info.summary: Visual framework for web projects: design system, React and Astro components with Tailwind, shadcn and motion, skills, dependency and MCP setup, and Playwright screen captures.
info.description: Visual framework for web projects: design system, React and Astro components with Tailwind, shadcn and motion, skills, dependency and MCP setup, and Playwright screen captures. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "designfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture browser screenshots and inspect previous runs.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Capture each URL at the selected viewport sizes and color schemes.

arguments.name: urls
arguments.description: One or more HTTP or HTTPS URLs to capture.

options.name: --viewport
options.description: Use mobile, tablet, desktop, wide, or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Repeat or separate with commas. Defaults to capture.viewports.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Browser color schemes: light or dark. Repeat or separate with commas. Defaults to light.

options.name: --full-page
options.description: Capture the full page. Enabled by default.

options.name: --fold
options.description: Capture only the visible viewport.

options.name: --no-scroll
options.description: Skip scrolling and the asset readiness check before a full-page capture.

options.name: --scroll-budget
options.description: Time limit in milliseconds for full-page scrolling and asset readiness. Defaults to 15000.

options.name: --show-dev-overlays
options.description: Keep known framework development overlays visible.

options.name: --hide
options.description: Hide elements matching this CSS selector. Repeat to hide more elements.

options.name: --reduced-motion
options.description: Set the browser preference to reduced motion.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait this many milliseconds after page load. Defaults to zero.

options.name: --selector
options.description: Capture only the element matching this CSS selector.

options.name: --out
options.description: Capture root directory. Defaults to the capture.outDir setting.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name the run directory. Defaults to a UTC timestamp.

examples: designfy capture run http://localhost:4321 --viewport mobile,desktop --theme light,dark
designfy capture run http://localhost:4321 --viewport mobile --viewport tablet --fold
